verdict.rationale: ClickUp lists a first-party 'Automations' feature on its product page, so a native automation capability exists. Nothing in the evidence describes how it works: no trigger/condition/action chaining, no multi-step sequences, and no builder interface for non-coders. Event-triggered workflows on the developer site are an API building block, and n8n is a third-party tool, so neither earns credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of multi-step automation chains, a no-code visual builder, trigger/action catalog details, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
